name: RIVET EV Charging Site Underwriting Package
problem: A charging-site decision needs traffic, competition, demand, utility, incentive, parcel and amenity diligence assembled into one evidence-backed report.
intent_terms: evaluate this address for EV charging
inputs: Site/address, intended project context, buyer decision question and authorized site-specific inputs.
outputs: Address-specific siting and underwriting package with evidence-state labels, economics, competition, power/incentive context and next diligence.
pricing: Current hypothesis $500-$5,000 per site depending on depth; not auto-quotable yet.
confirmation: Discovery may be automatic. Payment, engineering representations and commitments require explicit confirmation/approval.
invocation_status: Discoverable capability; quote/payment verification required before sale.
